Package frc.spectrumLib.telemetry

Class Telemetry

java.lang.Object
dev.doglog.DogLog
frc.spectrumLib.telemetry.Telemetry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subsystem
public class Telemetry extends DogLog implements Subsystem
Telemetry and logging utility. Extends DogLog to provide structured logging and console output with priority levels.

Three tiers:

  • log(edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command) writes to the wpilog only. DogLog skips a record when the value has not changed, so a boolean or a state string costs nothing while it is steady; a double that moves every loop costs a record every loop.
  • logDash(java.lang.String, double) also publishes the value to NetworkTables at 10 Hz, for the Driver Station dashboard and the robot app. Use it for exactly the keys a dashboard shows; the whole log is not mirrored to NetworkTables unless the mirror switch is on (see start(boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean, boolean, frc.spectrumLib.telemetry.Telemetry.PrintPriority)).
  • slowLogThisLoop() is true every fifth loop. Wrap logs that do not need loop-rate resolution (currents, temperatures, vision status) in it.

On 2026-09-05 a roboRIO ran at 92 to 95 percent CPU on a 30 ms loop while every record was mirrored to NetworkTables and flushed every 20 ms, which cost a core. These tiers cut the volume to what is actually read.

    • start

      public static void start(boolean ntMirrorDefault, boolean captureDs, boolean captureNt, boolean captureConsole, boolean logExtras, boolean tunableOnFMS, Telemetry.PrintPriority priority)
      Starts the telemetry system.

      Values a dashboard needs are published to NetworkTables individually through logDash(java.lang.String, double); everything else stays in the wpilog. Mirroring every entry is opt-in through the "Telemetry/MirrorLogsToNT" switch, and is forced off whenever the FMS is attached regardless of the switch.

      Parameters:
      ntMirrorDefault - initial position of the mirror-everything switch. false for the robot; flip it in Elastic when AdvantageScope needs the full live stream

    • time

      public static void time(String key)
      Starts a timed span. Pair with timeEnd(String) on the same key.

      Replaces DogLog's timer so the result reaches the dashboard: the Scheduler/* spans are on the Elastic layout and are the primary record of loop time.

    • timeEnd

      public static void timeEnd(String key)
      Ends a timed span and logs its length in seconds, matching the units DogLog's timer used, so existing analysis of the Scheduler/* keys keeps working.

    • print

      public static void print(String output)
      Prints a message at Telemetry.PrintPriority.NORMAL priority. The message is always written to the DogLog "Prints" key but only echoed to stdout when the global priority allows it.

    • logAlerts

      public static void logAlerts()
      Logs any alert newly published under SmartDashboard/Alerts (errors, warnings, infos) to the "Alerts" DogLog key.

      Reads the subscribers' change queues rather than the current arrays, so a loop on which nothing changed does no NetworkTables read and allocates nothing.
